messages:
maya: Heads up — spotted a few runbook links under runtime/kv-cache returning 403 after the recent S3 path change. quick triage?

tom: yep, saw that in staging earlier. looks like the shortlinks weren't updated with the new slug.

maya: example curl showing the failure: `curl -I https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#retrieve` -> 403. I grabbed the failing anchors.

docs-bot: link-scan: 5 hits in `runtime/kv-cache` (staging). Suggested owner: eng-platform. Scan report: https://internal.scan/reports/1790043210

sam: @maya can you paste the exact paths here? I can throw together a sed PR unless someone else owns the runtime guide.

maya: sure — list: `/runtime/kv-cache#retrieve`, `/runtime/kv-cache#prefix-cache`, `/runtime/kv-cache/examples/embed-curl`, `/runtime/kvcache/setup` (old slug), plus one gif asset 403.

liz: assigning to @sam for a quick PR. @maya could you flag which one needs the gif rehost? :thumbsup:

sam: taking this. plan: replace shortlinks with canonical `/docs/runtime/...` URLs, rehost the gif to CDN, run lint. aiming to have PR up by EOD.

tom: if it's touching API examples, add `@docs` in the CODEOWNERS review. small changes should be quick.

maya: added ticket DOCS-6123 to track and linked the failing curl snippet in the ticket.

docs-bot: PR checklist reminder — include `rel=canonical` sanity and CI linkcheck.

sam: opened PR #2314: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/2314 — reviewers @liz @tom. PR replaces shortlinks, updates one gif reference to `cdn.internal.redwood/assets/kv-cache-fix.gif`.

liz: LGTM on the edits, small nit on alt text for the gif (suggestion in PR comment). will review formally now.

docs-bot: re-run link-scan scheduled in 30m for branch `sam/kv-link-fix`.

sam: thanks — will address alt text, merge after CI. ping here when merged.

maya: awesome, thanks all. this should remove the runtime SRE alert we've been seeing in staging.
